items.title: Retire the T3 helper's V1 transport while keeping saved requests readable

checks.command: unshare -rn env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --offline --no-project --with pytest==9.1.1 --with websocket-client==1.9.2 pytest -p no:cacheprovider t3-start-thread/tests -q -k 'first_socket or never_retries'
unshare -rn env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --offline --no-project --with pytest==9.1.1 --with websocket-client==1.9.2 pytest -p no:cacheprovider t3-start-thread/tests -q

unshare -rn env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --offline --no-project --with pytest==9.1.1 --with websocket-client==1.9.2 pytest -p no:cacheprovider t3-start-thread/tests -q -k 'old_record or partial_launch or archived_launch or lost_reply or accepted or before_acceptance or start_and_resume or send_and_resume'

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('t3-start-thread/references/helper.md').read_text()
section = text.split('## Server and record compatibility', 1)[1].split('\n## ', 1)[0]
server, records = section.split('Request records are a separate matter', 1)
assert 'speaks only T3' in server and 'V2 orchestration protocol' in server
assert 'without a retry or V1 fallback' in server
assert 'V1-only' in server and 'not supported' in server
assert 'thread.turn.start' in records and 'original IDs' in records
assert 'saved before the' in records and 'resumes against a V2 server' in records
assert 'either protocol' not in text and 'detects the protocol' not in text
print('PASS: reference separates V2-only server support from old-record support')
PY
